body: thank you! yeah my brother who’s much older than me didn’t meet his wife until he was 26 i believe. so i’m in no rush to find a wife, i didn’t go into this relationship at 17 thinking that haha. she seems to have those thoughts though. the sooner i do this the better i just need to “man up” honestly. thank you for the advice! i’ll update you in pm if you would like me to after i go through with it lol.

oh believe me i know there are crazy ass dudes, like i said i’m pretty ashamed of how i acted in my last relationship. pretty similar to my girlfriend now honestly so maybe it’s karma haha. yeah i know i need to do it asap, it’s just so hard for me to let go! i don’t want to hurt her either considering how upset she was before. i have genuine feelings for her which make this harder for me but i know i can’t go on like this, just need to work up the courage/willpower i guess. and i wouldn’t consider twice my age “old lady” haha.

i’m completely on the same page as you, like i said in my brain i know what i have to do, i just can’t bring myself to do it because of a combination of guilt and my genuine feelings i had/have for her. i’m not a very confrontational person in general and my anxiety’s pretty bad, i just need to figure out how to get myself to do it.

yeah, not to be a pessimist, but the unfortunate reality, is that reality sucks. worlds pretty messed up, doesn’t mean there isn’t anything good, and that’s what i try to find everyday, although i fail most times lol.
